title: disavowal - tethered to doubt
description:
DIY. Recorded by a friend in the living room, bathroom, and garage of Linton House, an old house venue. Loud, noisy, aggressive, abrasive, grimey. Wall of sound. 

I had just joined the band when we recorded this, playing bass. I'm on drums now and most of these tracks have been shelved. 

 For fans of: Black Metal, Skramz, Noise, and Grindcore music.
